hotels.title: North Carolina Heritage Mountainside Retreat with Championship Golf Course & Subterranean Spa
hotels.description: Discover Asheville's best from this historic stay overlooking the Blue Ridge Mountains. This century-old resort is a haven of North Carolina hospitality, offering locally sourced cuisine at the upscale Vue 1913, craft cocktails at the rustic Great Hall Bar and a Donald Ross-designed championship golf course. Omni Grove Park Inn makes relaxation easy: enjoy time spent at the 43,000-square-foot subterranean The Spa, featuring eucalyptus steam rooms, therapeutic waterfalls and an oversized, mountain view hot tub.
